title: Yashil Uyim
shortDescription: Explore Yashil Uyim festival programs, news, gallery and venue details.
fullDescription:
Discover Yashil Uyim, an ecological festival bringing people together around nature and sustainable living. Browse published festival information in one place.

EXPLORE THE FESTIVAL
• Program: see activity times, topics and participants.
• Search: find a topic or participant that interests you.
• Saved activities: bookmark program items on your device.
• Announcements: read festival news and information about upcoming activities.
• Gallery: explore photos and videos from festival gatherings.
• Venue: check the date and address, then open an external map.

No registration or Telegram sign-in is required. The app does not sell tickets or accept payments.

An internet connection retrieves current information. Previously downloaded program and announcement text may remain available offline. Images, videos and external maps may require connectivity.

Saved activities remain on your device and are not linked to an account. The app does not request camera, contacts or precise-location permissions.

The interface and festival content are primarily in Uzbek. Festival details may change, so refresh the information before travelling.
releaseNotes: First release of Yashil Uyim: festival program, search, saved activities, announcements, gallery and venue information. No registration required.
